svg.title: What one judgement costs on the Claude side
svg.desc: Modelled for Opus 5.5 with 50K tokens of cached context. The Jev request itself adds $0.0001–0.0003. Horizontal bar chart, US dollars per judgement on the Claude side. Hook, nothing found (stays silent): $0 (claude-referee's default path). Hook adds a 300-char note: $0.0004 (claude-referee's default path). Haiku prompt hook (for comparison): $0.002 (other way to call a judge). CLI call, flags only: $0.012 (claude-referee's default path). CLI call, JSON via heredoc (decide): up to $0.017 (claude-referee's default path). MCP tool call: $0.017 (other way to call a judge). CLI call after writing a request file: $0.028 (other way to call a judge). Modelled, not measured. Measure yours: /usage in Claude Code; Jev side: npx claude-referee receipts --usage.
